name: NitroBet - settle Lite market and announce

parameters.content:
## How to use
1. Check the OFFICIAL race classification yourself.
2. In 'Set winner' type the winner exactly as shown in the app, and your Discord webhook URL.
3. Create a credential of type 'Header Auth' named 'NitroBet admin key': Name = X-Admin-Key, Value = your key. Pick it in 'Settle market (Lite)'.
4. Click Execute workflow.

Safety: this settles the free LITE market only. Never put a wallet private key in n8n. Full-tier results are posted from a multisig (Safe) by people who approve them.
